взуття; туфлі: things you wear on your feet
годинник (наручний): a small clock you wear on your wrist
капелюх; шапка: you wear it on your head
куртка; піджак: a short coat; also the top part of a suit
носити (одяг, окуляри): to have clothes, glasses etc. on your body
одяг: things you wear: shirts, trousers, dresses…
окуляри: you wear them to see better
пальто: a long warm piece of clothing you wear outside
розмір: how big or small clothes or shoes are
сорочка: a top with buttons and a collar
спідниця: a woman's piece of clothing that hangs from the waist
сукня: one piece of clothing for a woman, top and skirt together
сумка: you carry your things in it
футболка: a short-sleeved top with no buttons
черевики; чоботи: strong shoes that cover the ankle
шарф: a long piece of cloth you wear round your neck
шкарпетки: you wear them on your feet inside your shoes
штани: a piece of clothing for your legs; pants (US)
